# Read-only startup

Use this path for explanations, reviews, planning discussion, and orientation
that do not change repository state.

1. Resolve the active repository and read only existing `PROJECT.md`, `todo.md`,
   and directly relevant handoffs or plans.
2. When the normal memory layout is incomplete, give a transient orientation
   from what exists. State the missing paths and that explicit `kb-map setup`
   is required before mutating work.
3. Do not run cleanup, queue claims, bootstrap, refresh, session preservation,
   or route-history writes. Do not create directories just to make lookup neat.

Read-only routing is not an authorization bypass. A later edit, test wave,
setup, refresh, delegation, or maintenance action enters mutating startup first.
